checks.reason: PROD-MIX-02 proven on the live sandbox: the stored parent plan put the producer (S3 bucket) before the consumer (Lambda function) that depends on it, with one approved parent operation; its parent, desired and child-set digests, each child's subplan, semantics and effect digests and all 2 stable resource addresses were identical after the proposal, before the execution worker was stopped and at the end; the worker was stopped with the producer done and the consumer waiting for its review, the review was approved while it was down (306 s from stop to healthy) and the parent resumed after the restart; both durable receipts link their child operations, bind the semantics each child ran and re-derive from their own fields; the producer receipt was unchanged across the restart and AWS held the same one producer bucket before and after

PROD-MIX-03 partly proven: the trust change touched only the ExternalId of both sandbox roles and was restored; connection.verifyAws passed; the producer finished before the consumer started; both receipts link their child operations; the consumer's deployed PRODUCER_BUCKET_ARN equals the producer bucket ARN by independent readback. Approvals by an automated test approver through the browser path. Pending: the producer-change review and the one-use preauthorization refusal, which no product route can trigger.
